scope: Explicit exposure-only uncertain-outcome correction in StudentNoticesReader and RatingUpdatesController. Not part of the original optional-guard-only delta.

policy.eligible: Only supplied exposure guard plus current loaded exact captured array and serialized content, unchanged attempt scope, and network/timeout/cancelled with no HTTP status or server denial code.
policy.retention: Keep prior unread row without inferred readAt; set ratings source count unknown (null); expose manual unconfirmed status. No automatic retry. Existing no-guard manual failure behavior unchanged.
policy.cancellation: Before dispatch may send no mutation; after dispatch may already have committed remotely. Neither is represented as a rollback or confirmed read.
policy.invalidation: Original generation/session and exact rows, plus per-attempt private/safety/browsing/directory subscriptions. Hide, explicit cancel, reload, account switch, safety and scope invalidation cannot restore old rows.
policy.denials: Auth, forbidden, protocol, business/visibility, or any HTTP/server denial details still clear.
policy.baseErrorRender: CommunityController publishes error before onError, so the resulting exposure invalidation is not treated as proof of lost source authority.
